messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV3 — increased 5xx/429s from dedicated-gpu-pool-7 (us-west1). Alert window 21:07 UTC, error rate ~3.2% over 5m. Affected customers: tenant-42, tenant-hope. Routing backoff observed. Paging @alex (sre-oncall).

alex: ack — I’m on it, pulling logs now.

maria: I can see large KV-cache churn on pool-7, eviction spikes correlate with a worker restart. latency p95 up to 1.8s.

chris: tracing shows long tail on transformer forward pass and client retry storms. Host cpu 92% on node-gpu-07.

taylor: Can we hot-scale the pool and enable fallback to the quantized v1-small model for the affected routes? That should reduce per-token load.

alex: Doing a quick scale-up: running infra scale command.

```
# infra CLI
redwood infra scale --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-7 --replicas +2 --region us-west1
```

maria: Also triggering a targeted KV eviction throttle to reduce churn: setting eviction_max_concurrent=2.

chris: Routing rule change ready: temporary traffic-split 70/30 to pool-7 / pool-3 (us-east1) for routes matching tenant-42. Will push in 30s.

support-bot: Drafting customer notifications for tenant-42 and tenant-hope. @sasha please review then I’ll send.

sasha: Reviewed, suggested to include ETA estimate and mitigation steps. I’ll call tenant-42 SOC after we confirm fallback.

alex: Post-mitigation check: error rate dropped to 0.4% after scale+fallback, latency p95 back to 420ms. Still tracking for 15m.

maria: Root cause hypothesis: eviction race during worker restart + bursty retry pattern. Need deeper post-incident analysis on the eviction logic and restart sequence.

alex: OK — this will be handed off to a post-incident review. Proposed postmortem meeting: tomorrow 16:00 PST. Who can own coordination?

taylor: I’ll own scheduling and write the initial postmortem doc.

alex: Nice. Action items (severity-based sizing):
- maria: Investigate eviction restart race + reproduce locally. Owner: maria. Size: L.
- chris: Implement safe KV eviction backoff and add unit/integration tests. Owner: chris. Size: M.
- taylor: Add automated fallback routing policy (policy + rollback playbook). Owner: taylor. Size: M.
- sasha: Update customer incident runbook + send follow-up notifications and SOC call notes. Owner: sasha. Size: S.
- support-bot: Add templated customer messages and track acknowledgement. Owner: support-bot. Size: S.
- alex: Add improved alert thresholds and synthetic checks for dedicated pools. Owner: alex. Size: S.

maria: +1 on sizes, will start reproducibility run and post logs to the doc. ETA 48h for initial findings.

chris: I’ll open a PR for eviction backoff; aiming for a small patch and tests — estimate 3d.

taylor: Scheduling the postmortem invite now for tomorrow 16:00 PST and creating a doc at /confluence/incidents/dedicated-pool-7-2026-03-16.

sasha: I’ll follow up with tenant SOC and include the customer impact summary in the postmortem.

alex: Thanks all — tagging next steps into remediation board and marking priorities: Maria/Chris are high priority (blocker for stable infra), Taylor/Sasha/support are follow-ups.

support-bot: Action items created in tracker: #INC-4521 (Maria), #INC-4522 (Chris), #INC-4523 (Taylor), #INC-4524 (Sasha).

chris: Quick note — can we include this in Q2 reliability OKRs? This eviction pattern could impact other pools.

alex: Agreed. I’ll add a tie-in to Q2 Reliability roadmap: "KV eviction robustness" under Platform > Serving runtime.

maria: closing loop — if anyone sees re-regression ping me directly.

alex: closing oncall here. Postmortem doc + action items will be owned in the tracker. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
